title: Donruss #146 Luke Kennard Los Angeles Clippers Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The NBA 2021 Donruss 146 Luke Kennard Los Angeles Clippers Card is a sports trading card featuring basketball player Luke Kennard from the Los Angeles Clippers. Manufactured by Donruss in 2021, this card is part of the Donruss set and is a great collectible for fans of the NBA and trading cards. The card does not include an autograph but is a must-have for collectors looking to add a piece of the 2021 season to their collection.
